entries.name: CA-CUSTOMER-NUM
entries.longDescription: A 10-digit numeric field within the communication area that uniquely identifies a customer record in the GenApp system. Used to retrieve, add, or update customer information across linked programs (LGICUS01, LGACUS01, LGUCUS01).

entries.name: CA-FIRST-NAME
entries.longDescription: An alphanumeric field in the communication area storing the customer's first name. Transferred between the presentation layer (LGTESTC1) and business logic programs for customer inquiries, additions, and updates.

entries.name: CA-LAST-NAME
entries.longDescription: An alphanumeric field in the communication area storing the customer's last name or surname. Essential for customer identification and record management across the GenApp customer transaction workflow.

entries.name: CA-DOB
entries.longDescription: A date field in the communication area representing the customer's date of birth. Used for customer verification, age calculations, and compliance requirements in insurance policy management.

entries.name: CA-HOUSE-NAME
entries.longDescription: An alphanumeric field storing the name of the customer's residence (e.g., 'Rose Cottage', 'The Willows'). Part of the customer's address information used for correspondence and policy documentation.

entries.name: CA-HOUSE-NUM
entries.longDescription: An alphanumeric field containing the street number or building number of the customer's residence. Combined with other address fields to form the complete customer address.

entries.name: CA-POSTCODE
entries.longDescription: An alphanumeric field storing the customer's postal code or ZIP code. Automatically converted to uppercase for standardization. Critical for address validation, geographic analysis, and mail delivery.

entries.name: CA-PHONE-MOBILE
entries.longDescription: An alphanumeric field containing the customer's mobile telephone number. Primary contact method for urgent communications, policy updates, and claim notifications.

entries.name: CA-PHONE-HOME
entries.longDescription: An alphanumeric field storing the customer's home or landline telephone number. Secondary contact method used for customer service calls and policy correspondence.

entries.name: CA-EMAIL-ADDRESS
entries.longDescription: An alphanumeric field containing the customer's email address. Used for electronic correspondence, policy documents, renewal notices, and digital communication preferences.

entries.name: CA-REQUEST-ID
entries.longDescription: A 5-character code identifying the type of business operation being performed. Values include '01ICUS' (Inquire Customer), '01ACUS' (Add Customer), '01UCUS' (Update Customer). Directs program flow to appropriate business logic modules.

entries.name: CA-RETURN-CODE
entries.longDescription: A numeric field indicating the success or failure status of linked program execution. A value greater than 0 indicates an error condition, triggering error handling routines and user notifications. In LGICUS01, it is initialized to '00' for success and set to '98' if the commarea length is insufficient.

entries.name: COMM-AREA
entries.longDescription: A 32,500-byte data structure used to pass information between CICS programs via EXEC CICS LINK commands. Contains all customer data fields and control information needed for transaction processing across the GenApp application.

entries.name: STSQ-NAME
entries.longDescription: An 8-character field with value 'GENACNTL' identifying the temporary storage queue used to track customer number ranges. Enables concurrent access control and maintains high/low customer number boundaries for the application.

entries.name: WS-FLAG-TSQH
entries.shortDescription: Working Storage Flag Temporary Storage Queue High
entries.longDescription: A single-character flag ('Y' or space) indicating whether the high customer number entry exists in the temporary storage queue. Controls logic for initializing or updating customer number tracking records.

entries.name: DFHCOMMAREA
entries.longDescription: The primary data structure used to pass information between CICS programs via EXEC CICS LINK commands. Contains all customer data fields, control information, and return codes needed for transaction processing across the GenApp application. In LGICUS01, it receives customer inquiry requests and returns customer details retrieved from the database.

entries.name: WS-REQUIRED-CA-LEN
entries.shortDescription: Working Storage Required Communication Area Length
entries.longDescription: A computed field that calculates the minimum required length of the communication area for the current transaction. Combines the customer data length (WS-CUSTOMER-LEN) with header/trailer overhead (WS-CA-HEADERTRAILER-LEN) to validate that the incoming commarea is large enough to process the customer inquiry request.

entries.name: LGICDB01
entries.shortDescription: Linked Program Name for Customer Inquiry Database Access
entries.longDescription: An 8-character literal field containing the program name 'LGICDB01', which is the database access layer program responsible for retrieving customer details from Db2. Used in the EXEC CICS LINK command to delegate database operations, following the 3-tier architecture pattern (presentation → business logic → data management).

entries.name: WS-CUSTOMER-LEN
entries.longDescription: A numeric field from the LGPOLICY copybook that defines the length of the customer data structure within the communication area. Used to calculate the minimum required commarea length (WS-REQUIRED-CA-LEN) to ensure sufficient space exists for customer inquiry data before processing the request.

entries.name: CA-NUM-POLICIES
entries.longDescription: A numeric field in the communication area that tracks the count of insurance policies associated with a customer. Initialized to '00' in LGICUS01 during customer inquiry processing and may be populated by downstream programs to indicate the total number of active policies for the customer.

entries.name: ERROR-MSG
entries.longDescription: A formatted error message structure containing date, time, program name (LGICUS01), and a variable error description field (EM-VARIABLE). Used to log diagnostic information to temporary storage queues via the LGSTSQ program when critical errors occur, such as missing commarea or validation failures.

entries.name: EM-VARIABLE
entries.longDescription: A 21-character field within the ERROR-MSG structure that contains the specific error description text. In LGICUS01, it is set to ' NO COMMAREA RECEIVED' when the program is invoked without a communication area, providing diagnostic context for error investigation.

entries.name: WS-CALEN
entries.longDescription: A computational field that stores the actual length of the received communication area (EIBCALEN). Used to validate that the incoming commarea meets the minimum required length before processing the customer inquiry request, preventing data truncation errors.

entries.name: WS-CA-HEADERTRAILER-LEN
entries.shortDescription: Working Storage Communication Area Header Trailer Length
entries.longDescription: A constant field with value +18 representing the fixed overhead bytes required for communication area header and trailer information. Added to the customer data length to calculate the total minimum commarea size needed for successful transaction processing.

entries.name: WS-ABSTIME
entries.longDescription: A computational field that stores the CICS absolute time value obtained via EXEC CICS ASKTIME. Used as input to EXEC CICS FORMATTIME to generate human-readable date and time stamps for error messages written to temporary storage queues.

entries.name: WS-DATE
entries.longDescription: An 8-character field that stores the formatted date in MMDDYYYY format, obtained by converting WS-ABSTIME via EXEC CICS FORMATTIME. Included in error messages (EM-DATE) to provide temporal context for diagnostic logging and troubleshooting.

entries.name: WS-TIME
entries.longDescription: An 8-character field that stores the formatted time obtained by converting WS-ABSTIME via EXEC CICS FORMATTIME. Included in error messages (EM-TIME) to provide precise timing information for error events and transaction auditing.

entries.name: CA-DATA
entries.longDescription: A 90-character field within the CA-ERROR-MSG structure that captures a snapshot of the communication area contents when errors occur. Used for diagnostic purposes to log the first 90 bytes (or actual length if smaller) of the commarea to temporary storage queues, enabling analysis of invalid or malformed input data.

entries.name: WS-ADDR-DFHCOMMAREA
entries.shortDescription: Working Storage Address of CICS Communication Area
entries.longDescription: A POINTER field that stores the memory address of the DFHCOMMAREA structure. Set via the SET statement to establish addressability to the communication area, enabling the program to access and manipulate commarea fields during customer inquiry processing.
